title: eludite.nuget.manage input
description: Project > Manage NuGet Packages... (a project's context menu) and Manage NuGet Packages for Solution... (the solution's): open the Manage NuGet Packages window as a document tab, scoped to the project, or to every project with the project list's check boxes. Opening it reads the installed packages; Browse searches only when its tab shows. The output is the window's place (view-tool-window.output.json).

project.description: A project of the open solution: its name (`App`) or the absolute path of its project file.
